Delhi Lakshmi Yojana 2026 : Form Details
What is Delhi Lakshmi Yojana?
  • The Delhi Lakshmi Yojana aims to provide monthly financial assistance to economically weaker women and help them become financially independent. The Delhi Government has allocated ₹5,110 crore for this scheme in the 2026–27 budget. The scheme was earlier known as the Mahila Samriddhi Yojana, and its name has now been changed to Delhi Lakshmi Yojana. According to the notification issued by the Delhi Government’s Department of Women and Child Development on 6 August 2026, the scheme came into effect from 1 August 2026 and will initially remain in operation for three years. Under this scheme, eligible women will receive ₹2,500 per month. The amount will be transferred to beneficiaries through digital means and savings accounts. The scheme focuses on promoting women’s financial independence, decision-making ability, and self-reliance.
How Will Women Receive ₹2,500 Every Month?
  • Option 1
  • ₹1,500 per month will be deposited into an RD (Recurring Deposit) or FD (Fixed Deposit) account.
  • ₹1,000 will be provided through a CBDC (Central Bank Digital Currency) wallet, which can be used only to purchase essential items approved by the government.
  • Option 2
  • The beneficiary can choose to have the entire ₹2,500 deposited directly into an RD or FD account.
Delhi Lakshmi Yojana 2026 : Who Can Apply?
  • A woman must fulfill all of the following conditions to be eligible:
  • Age should be between 21 and 60 years.
  • The family’s annual income should be ₹2.5 lakh or less.
  • The woman or her family must have been a resident of Delhi for at least 10 years.
  • Only one woman per family can receive the benefit.
  • Priority will be given to the oldest eligible woman in the family.
Delhi Lakshmi Yojana 2026 : Who Will Not Be Eligible?
  • Women belonging to the following categories will not be eligible:
  • Women who pay Income Tax.
  • Women who file GST returns.
  • Government employees or women whose family member works in a government department or PSU.
  • Women who are already receiving benefits under another government financial assistance scheme.
  • Families owning a four-wheeler vehicle.
  • Families whose annual electricity consumption exceeds 2,400 units.
  • Families having more than three children.
  • Women with a criminal record.
Delhi Lakshmi Yojana 2026 : Documents Required 
  • Aadhaar Card
  • Delhi Voter ID
  • Passport-size Photograph
  • Signature
  • Recommendation Letter from the Local MLA or MP
 How To Fill Delhi Lakshmi Yojana 2026
  • Visit the official Delhi Lakshmi Yojana portal.
  • Complete new registration.
  • Verify your mobile number and Aadhaar.
  • Enter all the required personal details.
  • Upload the necessary documents.
  • Select the preferred payment option — RD/FD or CBDC.
  • Submit the application and keep the application receipt safely for future reference.

  • Answer: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana is a financial assistance scheme for eligible women in Delhi. Under this scheme, eligible women will receive ₹2,500 per month.
  • Question: When did Delhi Lakshmi Yojana 2026 start?
  • Answer: The scheme came into effect from 1 August 2026.
  • Question: How much financial assistance will women receive?
  • Answer: Eligible women will receive ₹2,500 every month.
  • Question: Who can apply for Delhi Lakshmi Yojana?
  • Answer: Women aged 21 to 60 years, with a family annual income of ₹2.5 lakh or less, who meet the Delhi residency and other eligibility conditions can apply.
  • Question: How will the ₹2,500 be provided?
  • Answer: Beneficiaries can choose between RD/FD deposits or a combination of RD/FD and CBDC wallet as specified under the scheme.
  • Question: How many women are expected to benefit from the scheme?
  • Answer: The scheme is expected to benefit more than 17 lakh women
  • Question: What documents are required for registration?
  • Answer: Aadhaar Card, Delhi Voter ID, passport-size photograph, signature, and a recommendation letter from the local MLA or MP are listed as required documents.
  • Question: Can more than one woman from the same family receive the benefit?
  • Answer: No. Only one woman per family can receive the benefit, with priority given to the oldest eligible woman.
  • Question: Who is not eligible for Delhi Lakshmi Yojana?
  • Answer: Income-tax payers, GST return filers, certain government employee families, beneficiaries of other government financial assistance schemes, families owning a four-wheeler, and those meeting other exclusion conditions are not eligible.
  • Question: How can I apply for Delhi Lakshmi Yojana 2026?
  • Answer: Applicants need to visit the official Delhi Lakshmi Yojana portal, complete registration, verify their Aadhaar and mobile number, upload the required documents, select the payment option, and submit the application.
  • Question: What is the official website for Delhi Laxmi Yojana?
  • Answer: The official website for Delhi Laxmi Yojana is https://dly.delhi.gov.in/
